newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Great Central in farm-in agreements.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Great Central in farm-in agreements.

text.p: Gold producer Great Central Gold Mines NL said on Monday it has entered into a farm-in agreement with Eagle Bay Resources NL covering the old Bronzewing tenements in Western Australia.
The Bronzewing tenements P36/1059, P36/1060 and MLA 36/331 are located six kms north of Great Central's Bronzewing gold mine, it said.
Great Central said it can earn a 70 percent interest in the tenements by spending A$150,000 on exploration in the first year and a further A$300,000 on exploration by the end of year three.
At that time, Great Central might elect to increase its interest to 80 percent by sole funding further exploration to the completion of a bankable feasibility study, Great Central said.
However, the company might withdraw at any time provided it has spent A$150,000 on exploration, it said.
